The '''''Thief's Eye''''' was the personal [[Peregrine-class star yacht|''Peregrine''-class star yacht]] of the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]].

==History==
[[File:ThiefsEye-WitchesOfTheMist.png|thumb|left|200px|''Thief's Eye'' docked at the Toydarian palace]]
Katuunko traveled in the ship to the coral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] for [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|negotiations]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to build a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] base in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]]. Upon Katuunko rejecting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist's]] offer of an alliance, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] assassin, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], detonated bombs near the ship, causing the Toydarian ship to be severely damaged.

However, the ship was repaired and stationed at the [[Toydarian palace/Legends|Toydarian palace]] when [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] new assassin, [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], arrived on the planet and went through a deadly rampage, kidnapping Katuunko and destroying the [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] used by the pursuing [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The Jedi used the ''Thief's Eye'' to follow Opress to Dooku's flagship.
